summary: Iteration 17 — verified the CAD-redrawn Floor Plan (inline cadSvg) and the two prior bug fixes on 54 Greenmere (34850d44-8a95-40f4-b8a5-f733546807f1). BACKEND 9/9 pass (/app/backend/tests/test_iter17_cad_floorplan.py, run with -n 0): saved a marker -> POST /floorplan/auto-detect -> polled to floorPlanDetecting=false (finished in ~35s, no floorPlanDetectError); floorPlan.markers STILL contained TEST_keep (marker-preservation fix holds), floorPlan.autoDetected=true, source='Assessment — page 27', floorPlan.cadSvg is a valid non-empty SVG string (>1KB, <svg>..</svg>), floorPlan.cadData.rooms is a non-empty list with named rooms, imageUrl still downloadable as image/* (>5KB). Exactly ONE non-deleted doc_type='Floor Plan' document remains after auto-detect (orphan-supersede fix holds; previous iteration had 7). GET /pack.pdf -> 200, %PDF- magic, 29.4MB. FRONTEND (Playwright, 1920x1080 + 1920x2200): login OK -> project -> Open Design Workspace -> nav-floorplan -> floorplan-panel; floorplan-sheet visible and floorplan-cad-svg renders exactly one inline <svg> (748x1064) containing real content: 'Outbuilding, Kitchen, Wet Room, Bedroom 2, Living Room, Bedroom 1', full dimension chains (3.85/1.50/3.40/2.95/0.90/1.50/1.00/2.40 m), 'Main GF' data box (H=2.47m, HLP=18.95m, P/L=13.0m, Area=53.72m2, Filled Cavity Walls 300mm, 1930-1949, Mid-Terrace Bungalow), north arrow, NOT TO SCALE + wall-type checkboxes, signature strip. Badge reads 'Redrawn to CAD from Assessment — page 27'. HTML titleblock (floorplan-titleblock) correctly NOT rendered when cadSvg present (count=0). Marker flow over the SVG works: floorplan-tool-DMEV -> canvas click -> floorplan-marker-0 created -> Save -> 'saved' toast -> marker persists after full reload; remove+save cleans up. Deep link /project/{id}/design/floorplan also renders the SVG. ZERO console/page errors across the whole run.

design_issues.screen: Floor Plan panel — CAD SVG sheet
issues: Large dead whitespace: the plan + data box occupy only the top ~40% of the sheet; ~330px of empty sheet sits between the drawing and the bottom signature strip. Consider scaling the drawing up or shortening the sheet viewBox.

Left vertical dimension chain is detached from the building: the '4.10 m' and '2.40 m' segments continue ~200px BELOW the outer wall outline (into empty space), so the chain does not correspond to the drawn geometry. The stray '1.45 m' segment above the top-left corner is likewise not tied to a wall.
'0.90 m' bottom dimension text overlaps the 'Front Door' leader label.
The requested LEGEND / NOTES blocks are absent from the SVG — only the abbreviation key (HSI/C/O/EL) inside the Main GF data box is present.
Data-box and page-number text is very small (~5-6px effective) at the 748px sheet width; the sheet is still max-w-3xl while the workspace column is much wider (carry-over from iteration 16).

action_items: Cosmetic only: tighten the SVG sheet layout (remove bottom dead space, clip/attach the left dimension chain to actual wall extents, fix '0.90 m' vs 'Front Door' text overlap).
Optionally add the LEGEND/NOTES blocks referenced in the design brief to cad_floorplan.build_cad_floorplan_svg.
Optionally widen the drawing sheet (currently max-w-3xl) to use the available workspace width.
critical_code_review_comments: FloorPlanPanel.jsx injects fp.cadSvg via dangerouslySetInnerHTML — the SVG is server-generated so risk is low, but it is built from LLM output; consider sanitising (strip <script>/on* attrs) in cad_floorplan.build_cad_floorplan_svg before persisting.

FloorPlanPanel.jsx autoDetect() poll loop is still unbounded on repeated fetch failure and has no unmount cleanup (carry-over from iteration 16, unfixed).
